column1: # Archive style-study coverage, 2026-10-11 UTC — completed unique-prose reading pass
# Full scan is separate from semantic reading. All 200 narrative-bearing sources plus six lore/guidance references have complete assigned semantic coverage.
# N=standalone; C=compilation; S=superseded; L=lore/technique reference; G=guidance; I=index; D=derived cast.
# prose/notes/blocks are heuristic word-unit classifications; embedded in-world documents and unheaded mechanics need manual register judgment.
# kept/excess count exact candidate paragraphs >=20 words once after whitespace normalization. Shorter/edited variants remain; counting order is not canon precedence.
# direct_read_words includes prose and separately classified notes, mechanics, references and headings. Exact linked copies are not reread or additional style votes.
# close_ranges are direct-read complete paragraphs, merged across intervening blank lines. Linked_ranges are exact copies whose directly read originals were hash/range verified.
# UNIQUE_COMPLETE means all source paragraphs were directly read or exact-linked; DIRECT_COMPLETE means every paragraph directly read. L/G reads are references, not fiction.

# INDEX_SCAN means metadata inspected/scanned, not scene close-read. DERIVED_LINK means cast body checked against read source after removing tags/punctuation; Verinus line109 has reviewed testament-to/proof-of variant.
# readers name root and six local read-only workers. Root supplemented initial reading and owns documentation. No external AI calls.
# source_sha256 is a full current-source digest. All 214 source files retained their initial bytes. The fresh Unbending Scale chat transcript is separate, fully read, not archived here.
